The modern Scottsdale limo is a Sprinter

Most people searching for a limo in Scottsdale picture a long, low car. What actually works here is different. Scottsdale nights involve groups of 10 to 30, 110-degree evenings, and venues where everyone wants to arrive together. Our fleet is built around Mercedes Sprinters and larger vehicles: stand-up headroom, lounge seating, real air conditioning, and room for the whole group in one vehicle.

The closest thing to a classic limousine in the fleet is the Chrysler Limo, seating 8 at $150 per hour, and the Pink Hummer Limo, seating 18 at $295 per hour. Everything else is a Sprinter, a party bus, or one of our executive buses.

What each part of Scottsdale books

Old Town Scottsdale. Nights out on the Entertainment District — bottles at the clubs, dinner on Main Street, bar loops around Scottsdale Road and Camelback. Groups book the Limo Party Sprinter or the Party Bus (28 Pax), and the chauffeur handles the drop-off and pickup points so nobody hunts for parking. Our Scottsdale nightlife transportation page covers the evening in detail.

North Scottsdale. Weddings at the resorts and desert venues along the 101 corridor, plus dinners at the Kierland and Scottsdale Quarter area. The Executive White Sprinter is the favorite for wedding parties; couples book the Maybach Jet Sprinter for their own exit. See wedding transportation in Scottsdale.

Gainey Ranch, McCormick Ranch, and Central Scottsdale. Golf mornings, anniversary dinners, and small-group airport runs. The Luxury SUV and Executive Black Sprinter do most of this work.

Paradise Valley border. Estate weddings and private events where a Sprinter stages on the property. We cover Paradise Valley in depth in our Paradise Valley limo guide.

Sky Harbor transfers. A one-way airport transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included: $225 in the Luxury SUV, $295 in an Executive Sprinter. Flight tracking is included, and the chauffeur texts when you land. Details are on the Phoenix airport Sprinter van page.

What a Scottsdale night actually costs

Bachelorette night, Old Town, 5 hours. Fourteen riders in a Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax): 5 hours at $175 is $875, or about $945 with tax. Split 14 ways, that is roughly $68 per person for the whole night — door-to-door, with the cooler stocked from your own cart and nobody driving. More on bachelorette party Sprinters.

Wedding shuttle, North Scottsdale, 8 hours. An Executive White Sprinter moving the wedding party between hotel, venue, and after-party: 8 hours earns 1 free hour, so 7 bill at $145, or $1,015, about $1,096 with tax.

Concert run, 4 hours. Nine friends in the Maybach Jet Sprinter at $295: $1,180, or about $1,274 with tax — about $131 each. Parking and traffic are the chauffeur's problem, not yours.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a limo in Scottsdale?
Between $125 and $295 per hour depending on the vehicle, with a 4-hour minimum on most of the fleet. A typical Old Town night runs $700 to $1,250 before tax depending on group size and hours.

Is there a minimum number of hours?
Four hours on the Sprinters, limos, party buses, and Luxury SUV. Airport transfers carry no hourly minimum.

Can we bring drinks?
Trips are BYOB for groups where everyone is 21 or older. The rules are in our guide to drinking on a party bus in Arizona.

How far ahead should we book?
Availability varies by date, and Barrett-Jackson week, the WM Phoenix Open and spring-training weekends are major-event dates. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open.
